g.text: Caterham dry-sump oil-temperature gauge: ADS1115 front end with harness protection

g.desc: Caterham dry-sump oil-temperature gauge: ADS1115 front end with harness protection

g.text: Generated from the design table; checked by ERC and DRC schematic parity

g.desc: Generated from the design table; checked by ERC and DRC schematic parity

fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Plugs into the 8-way socket on the back of the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75 case.

g.desc: Plugs into the 8-way socket on the back of the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75 case.

g.text: J1 order matches the case label: 18 (SCL), 17 (SDA), 16, RX, TX, 3.3V, G, 5V. GPIO16, RX and TX are unused.

g.desc: J1 order matches the case label: 18 (SCL), 17 (SDA), 16, RX, TX, 3.3V, G, 5V. GPIO16, RX and TX are unused.

g.text: Harness faults (a wire at 14.4 V): R3/R5 limit clamp current to about 10 mA each into +3V3;

g.desc: Harness faults (a wire at 14.4 V): R3/R5 limit clamp current to about 10 mA each into +3V3;

g.text: D1/D2 hold the taps inside GND..VDD; D3 limits transients on the signal wire and does not conduct at 14.4 V.

g.desc: D1/D2 hold the taps inside GND..VDD; D3 limits transients on the signal wire and does not conduct at 14.4 V.

g.text: R1 then dissipates about 0.26 W, R3/R5 about 0.11 W each. The display board's load absorbs the rail current.

g.desc: R1 then dissipates about 0.26 W, R3/R5 about 0.11 W each. The display board's load absorbs the rail current.

g.text: Vp = AIN0 - AIN3 across R1 (Rp), Vs = AIN3 - AIN1 across the sender, Rs = Rp x Vs / Vp.

g.desc: Vp = AIN0 - AIN3 across R1 (Rp), Vs = AIN3 - AIN1 across the sender, Rs = Rp x Vs / Vp.

g.text: Layout rules: R2 joins R1 pin 1 by its own trace (Kelvin), nothing in series between R1 and J2 pin 1,

g.desc: Layout rules: R2 joins R1 pin 1 by its own trace (Kelvin), nothing in series between R1 and J2 pin 1,

g.text: R3 and R5 tap the harness pins directly, R7 (break-detect bias) stays on the harness side of R5.

g.desc: R3 and R5 tap the harness pins directly, R7 (break-detect bias) stays on the harness side of R5.

g.text: 5 V from a separate automotive 12 V -> 5 V converter enters on J2 pin 3; D4 stops USB-C power

g.desc: 5 V from a separate automotive 12 V -> 5 V converter enters on J2 pin 3; D4 stops USB-C power

g.text: feeding back into the converter when both are connected.

g.desc: feeding back into the converter when both are connected.
